outcome: Expression of NICD2 and NICD3 proteins
cohort: The study included placental tissue samples from 20 late preterm or term pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia and 20 normal pregnancies.
finding: NOTCH2, NOTCH3, DLL3, DLL4, JAG1, JAG2, HEY1, HEY2 mRNA levels and NICD2, NICD3 protein levels were significantly downregulated in placentas from pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia compared to controls.
mod_finding: HEY2 transcript levels were significantly associated with the mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth/delivery (placental tissue samples).
birth_weight: Birth weight centile was measured and associated with NICD3 protein levels and DLL3 mRNA levels.
